title: Senate staff meet Mellon, Puthoff, Davis, the Skinwalker team and the Tic Tac pilots
place_text: Capitol Hill, Washington, D.C.; Skinwalker Ranch, Utah

tellings.quote: I saw his name associated with this and it was easy to uh reconnect with with Chris and we met Lou and we met Dr. Put off and Dr. Davis and uh um uh we met the f other folks who had been working on the um on the ranch in uh in in in Utah and we met Brandon Fugal,

plain: In 2017 and 2018, Senate staff are said to have met with many of the main figures in the UFO story, says Kurt McConnell, a Senate staffer who was there. He tells Michels he got back in touch with a man he already knew, Chris Mellon. Through him they met Luis Elizondo, who ran AATIP, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports; the physicists Hal Puthoff and Eric Davis; the team that had worked at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah ranch known for reports of strange events; and Brandon Fugal, who is linked to the ranch. They also met the Navy pilots David Fravor and Alex Dietrich, who saw the Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint. If true, the subject reached Congress through private briefings well before any public hearing.
